from copy import deepcopy


def colon_tuplex(tuplex, m, n):
    """Write a function to get a colon of a tuple."""
    tuplex_colon = deepcopy(tuplex)
    tuplex_colon[m].append(n)
    return tuplex_colon
", "tests/test_solution.py": "import solution


def test_module_imports():

    assert solution.colon_tuplex(("HELLO", 5, [], True), 2, 50) == ("HELLO", 5, [50], True)


def test_colon_tuplex_appends_to_existing_list():
    assert solution.colon_tuplex((1, [1, 2], "x"), 1, 3) == (1, [1, 2, 3], "x")


def test_colon_tuplex_does_not_mutate_original():
    original = ("HELLO", 5, [], True)
    result = solution.colon_tuplex(original, 2, 50)
    assert result == ("HELLO", 5, [50], True)
    assert original == ("HELLO", 5, [], True)
